sources.snippet: FrozenLake Q-Learning Agent - Model Documentation Model Overview This is a Q-Learning agent trained to solve the FrozenLake-v1 environment from OpenAI Gymnasium. The agent learns to navigate a frozen lake from start to goal while avoiding holes in the ice using tabular Q-learning with epsilon-greedy exploration.
